Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Livingston
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 04/02/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 354 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Brown (C)
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 138 as introduced would reduce the expenditures of the Secretary of State by an estimated $7,500 annually by requiring the Secretary of State to maintain electronically digital copies of all bills, joint resolutions, and memorials rather than: (1) providing 10 printed copies of all bills, joint resolutions, and memorials upon the request of either house of the Legislature, and (2) binding a copy of each and filing the bound and non-bound copies in the office of the Secretary of State, as provided by current law.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
